target_customer: Companies deploying internal AI agents, buyers in IT and security
problem: Static access rules and manual approvals cannot judge whether an agent's action fits its current task.
business_model: B2B software that trains company-specific approval models, pricing not found

founders.name: Aman Raj
founders.background_notes: Also led product at a consumer AI startup, per YC page.

founders.name: Sarthak Aggarwal
founders.background_notes: Led Conquest, described by the YC page as Asia's largest student-run accelerator.

competitors.name: Delinea
competitors.what: Runtime authorization for AI agents enforcing policy before execution

competitors.name: Curity
competitors.what: Access Intelligence issuing tokens per agent action with human approval for risky operations

competitors.name: Kontext Security
competitors.what: Runtime enforcement evaluating AI agents in real time

technical_complexity.rationale: Training small per-company models that make reliable allow or deny decisions needs ML and security rigor.

defensibility.rationale: Per-customer models trained on action history can lock in, but large IAM vendors ship similar runtime authorization.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Several incumbents launched runtime agent authorization in 2026, the same year Decawork launched.

market_need_then: Analysts expected a wave of agent runtime authorization products in 2026 as enterprise agents spread.

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and concise: 'Let agents work. Control every action.'

branding.brand_signature: Let agents work. Control every action.
branding.community_and_virality: Product Hunt featured badge on the site; no wider press found.

brand_strength.rationale: Short tagline and Product Hunt feature, but no press on the brand and a name that does not explain itself.

outcome_analysis: Decawork is a months-old AI agent control startup with a clear thesis but heavy incumbent competition from identity vendors launching the same runtime authorization in 2026. No outcome events were found and funding is unconfirmed, so its result is unknown.
notes: Unverified aggregator funding: VCBacked and EveryDev say $500K pre-seed (September or August 2026), Dealroom says $125K seed. None confirmed by company or press, so no round recorded. Competitor entries post-date the batch start in some cases (Delinea July 2026). Prior employer for Aman Raj's fintech and consumer AI startup not named. Completeness pass 2026-11: the $500K pre-seed (2026-09) is now recorded; it rests on a single database (VCBacked). Dealroom instead lists a $125K seed, unreconciled. No press confirmation.
